## Luna quick start · checked 18 October 2026

- Open the saved [Pilates page](https://sportclubmatch.nl/en/fitness/pilates/). It is a Pilates listing, even though the source entry title mentions Zumba Gold.
- Copy only the posted Pilates class times and the stated single-session, monthly, and one-time membership prices. The page shows recurring hours, not individually dated sessions.
- Mark the exact date and spoken language as unstated; do not carry Zumba Gold details onto this Pilates page.
- Stop if the requested activity is Zumba Gold or needs a dated occurrence; this saved page does not verify either.

Copyable prompt: `Read https://sportclubmatch.nl/en/fitness/pilates/ for {start_date} to {end_date}. Report only the Pilates times and prices this page explicitly shows, distinguishing drop-in, monthly class, and one-time membership fees. Mark exact dates and spoken language unstated. Stop if the request is for Zumba Gold or a dated Pilates occurrence; do not infer either from weekly hours.`

## Recheck rules

- Use public, actual date-selectable pages for dated records. A recurring weekly schedule or opening hours is not an occurrence; never expand recurrence.
- Verify that a single visit is allowed for one person, the exact regular single-person price, and any eligibility conditions, class-booking requirements, rentals, or other extras. A gym day pass does not imply group-class admission.
- Keep unknown prices, class inclusion, audience rules, language, dates, and availability unknown. Keep women-only, intro-only, member-only, or other conditions explicit.
- Do not create accounts, book, pay, contact organizers, enter gated flows, or bypass access controls.
- Apply the current profile settings when selecting offerings.
